title: Separable residue extensions of a Noetherian pair henselization
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and I an ideal. Let c be a colimit cocone for the full category of etale maps A to D inducing bijections A/I to D/ID, and suppose B=c.pt.right is Noetherian. Let q be a prime of B and p its contraction to A. Give B its structure A-algebra and let rho be the canonical A-algebra residue map from kappa(p) to kappa(q). Then, using rho for the extension algebra structure, kappa(q) is separable algebraic over kappa(p).

source.place: Tag 0AH1, lemma-filtered-colimit-etale-noetherian-fibres; Tag 0AH3, lemma-henselization-pair-G-ring, displayed product-of-fibres calculation with the completion replaced by an arbitrary B-algebra C.

proof.text: The defining pair-etale category is essentially small and filtered. Via the characterization of ind-morphisms as ind-objects in the under-category, apply ObjectProperty.of_essentiallySmall_index to the given colimit presentation. Each object is etale, hence the structure map of c is ind-etale.

Install the compatible residue scalar tower given by rho.comp_algebraMap. The already-proved source-library lemma Algebra.IndEtale.isSeparable_of_algHom_to_isLocalRing makes the image of each b in B separable over kappa(p). Every element of kappa(q) is a quotient of images of elements of B: use IsFractionRing.div_surjective over B/q and surjectivity of the quotient map. The separable closure is a field and is closed under division, so all elements are separable.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0AH1, separability component, using the proved source-library ind-etale residue-element lemma in WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.IndEtale.

lean.statement:
theorem pair_henselization_fiber_separable
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (c : Cocone (ObjectProperty.ι
      (fun D : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map D.hom) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map D.hom.hom) D.hom.hom
            (Ideal.le_comap_map)))))
    (hc : IsColimit c) [IsNoetherianRing c.pt.right]
    (q : Ideal c.pt.right) [q.IsPrime] :
    letI := c.pt.hom.hom.toAlgebra
    let p := q.comap c.pt.hom.hom
    ∀ (ρ : p.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.ResidueField),
      ρ = Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p q (Algebra.ofId A c.pt.right) rfl →
      letI := ρ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsSeparable p.ResidueField q.ResidueField
